course.title: AARAMBH 2.0 PLUS 9th BATCH 26-27
course.description:
We will cover Science, Mathematics, Social Science, English, Hindi, Information Technology (IT), AI, and Sanskrit for Class 9th students according to NEW NCERT.
If your school is following Old NCERT - We’ll provide recorded lectures of old NCERT also.
This is a Live Interactive Course, and the complete syllabus will be covered by October. However, you will have access to the course until your exams.

Note: English, Hindi, Sanskrit and Information Technology (IT) will be available in recorded mode.

Live Doubt-Solving Sessions will be conducted as part of this course.
Class Recordings will be available immediately after the live sessions on the Next Toppers app.
Class Notes will be provided in PDF format for each session on the Next Toppers app.
Frequent Tests will be conducted to assess your progress after completing specific portions of the syllabus.
The entire course will remain accessible to you until your exam.
This course price is for complete batch (not monthly).
In AARAMBH PLUS Old NCERT (Recorded Batch) + ABHAY (Crash Course) 2026-27 included.
This batch is non-refundable and non-transferable
